WV10-P01.4.note: A bargain is struck when its terms are agreed, so 'struck' means concluded; the colon introduces the agreed terms, not any pressing, igniting, realizing, or removing.

WV10-P01.5.note: His eyes stay on the split and his reply is all precautions against the board cracking (stove low, doors shut, ring at a pistol-shot crack, checking the board before the recital), which signals worry.
